en: A sepia-toned historical postcard showing an ornate stone staircase leading up to the entrance of a richly decorated Renaissance-style building. The staircase has carved balustrades, statues, and reliefs. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing stand around the base and on the steps. The architecture suggests a town hall or civic building. At the bottom of the image, printed text identifies the location.
